newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan shareholder demands Yamaichi executives suit.
newsitem.headline: Japan shareholder demands Yamaichi executives suit.

text.p: An individual shareholder in Nara prefecture, western Japan, has demanded that a lawsuit be filed against executives at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd over the brokerage's suspected illegal deals with a corporate racketeer, a lawyer for the shareholder said on Wednesday.

The lawyer, Tadashi Matsumaru, told Reuters that the shareholder has sent a letter to Yamaichi's auditors, calling on them to file a lawsuit against Yamaichi executives who were in office between June 1994 and January 1995.

The shareholder is demanding that Yamaichi collect 79 million yen in damages from its executives. Prosecutors are investigating Yamaichi on suspicion of making illegal stock deals to pay off a corporate racketeer who is at the heart of a financial scandal rocking Japan's business world.
If the Yamaichi auditors fail to take action within 30 days of the request, the shareholder will then pursue the filing of a class action suit with the Tokyo District Court, he said.
